description: Use when an agent is about to approve a spender, or is auditing what it approved before: how much of a token the spender may still move on the owner's behalf, raw and formatted with its decimals, plus unlimited, which flags a forgotten infinite approval. Do not use for what the wallet actually holds (/v1/evm/erc20-balance) or for whether the token is safe (/v1/evm/token-safety). No API key. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).
name: evm_erc20_allowance
title: ERC20 allowance
